full_page.content:
Bles'd be God in His Angels and in His Saints! Sept. 30th, 1947
God bless you Mrs. O'Connell You and yours.
Many thanks for your kind favor of the 27th.
God bless you too Maurice O'Connell. I hope this finds you improved and improving. However, I think you would do well to see a good Chiropractor. I was doctoring for at least three years for my feet and legs - using a cain for several months and quite lame. ...... In less than three week Dr. Ralph Schorn had me on my feet - with my cain a forgotten thing. His of- fice is just across Gratiot Ave. from the Airport - 10050 Connors Ave. Hoping this finds you 100% in God's grace and service .....
Yours Sincerely in Christ.
Fr. Solanus
O.F.M. Cap.
